decisions.statement: A key the page's page type does not declare secret is refused.
The refusal names the keys that page type declares.
The value a set replaces remains in the commit before that set.
A value arrives piped in rather than as an argument.
One trailing newline is dropped unless the call says to keep the newline.
A value with newlines of its own is taken whole.
A value that arrives empty is refused rather than taken as a usable value.
The secrets the sops file already has are carried into the file written.
Ciphertext carrying no sops mac is refused rather than written.
No value this command takes is written anywhere in the clear.
The composed file is not decrypted again before that file lands.
Two secrets valid only as a pair land in two commits rather than in one commit.

definition: the command enciphering one value into the sops file beside a page
